style.title: Stardew Valley-like
style.resolution: 16x16 for tiles and small items, 16x32 for tools and crops
style.perspective: top-down farming sim; items shown face-on or at a slight tilt, tiles read as a flat overhead surface
style.outlines: soft 1px brown or dark-tone outlines, never pure black; gentle interior shading rather than hard line work
style.lighting: warm soft daylight from the upper-left, low-contrast shadows in muted brown, cozy and inviting
style.palette: warm cozy farm palette: leafy greens, soil browns, golden wheat, and bright pastel accents for crops and flowers; seasonal variation in mind
style.rendering: clean readable pixel art with minimal dithering, small rounded color regions, no gradients
style.detail_density: medium-low; crops, tools, and produce stay simple and instantly readable at inventory size
style.shape_language: rounded friendly silhouettes with a little bounce; items centered with consistent padding, ground tiles tile seamlessly as flat overhead terrain
style.notes: Cozy farming-sim look: crops, farm tools, animals, fish, cooking, and seasonal terrain. Tiles are flat top-down surfaces; objects are centered sprites.
